title: First Battle of the Marne
summary: Six days on the Ourcq, the Petit and Grand Morin and the marshes of Saint-Gond: Maunoury's 6th Army strikes Kluck's open flank, Kluck swings his corps back to meet it and opens a gap to Bülow, the BEF and Franchet d'Espèrey's 5th Army walk into the gap, Foch holds at Saint-Gond, and on 9 September the German right wing retreats. This is the zoom-in seed — the hourly corps-level routes, the taxis, the Hentsch mission and the per-day beats are authored in sand-1l0.10.
outcome: German 1st and 2nd Armies retreat to the Aisne from 9 September; the Schlieffen timetable is dead and the mobile war in the West ends within the month.
